title: UWell Caliburn G3 Pro Koko Pod Vape Device
description:
Description
Specifications
This Kit Includes
The UWell Caliburn G3 Pro Koko Pod Vape Device features the first fine-tune airflow adjustment in the Caliburn series, offering a more customizable vaping experience. This compact kit boasts a sleek design that easily slips into your pocket and is equipped with a built-in massive 1250 mAh battery that lasts throughout the day. With adjustable output settings, you can effortlessly switch between MTL and RDTL vaping by using the included G3 pods.
The UWell Caliburn G3 Pro Koko sports an incredible 1.8″ TFTF display and also allows to switch out various themes to suit your mood.
As part of the Caliburn G3 family, the UWell Caliburn G3 Pro Koko Pod Vape Device is fully compatible with replacement pod cartridges designed for the G3 Series, ensuring high compatibility and stability in performance.
